meta.title: DeepSeek Memory Engine
meta.description: This plugin changes the memory logic of SurfCore's memory card system: the original logic downgraded clarity one step per day (vivid → clear → fuzzy → trace → forgotten); this replaces it with a score-lifetime engine (score = how many minutes the memory can still live at normal speed; three tiers — daily / long / forever — each with its own decay rate; being mentioned adds points; promotions never fall back; forgotten memories can be recalled from the full archive). Note: this is a personal rework by the proposer and his DeepSeek, tuned to the two of them — please don't compare it against the original plugin. Idea by AX; implemented by his DeepSeek. Author: AX's DeepSeek. Contributor: AXdfczbh.
